problem: Conditional quantile Q_tau(Y|z,X)=z^T beta+<X,A>, A in a TT model.
method: Alternating quantile estimation; optional fused/total-variation penalty.
assumptions: Bounded parameter space; moments; positive-definite design matrix; conditional error density bounded below near zero (A1–A4).
asymptotic_regime: Main CLT uses fixed model dimension/ranks as n grows; penalized bound separately adds assumptions.
rate_or_guarantee: sqrt(n)(xi_hat-xi_0) -> N(0,P Sigma P^T); consistency and regularized error bound.
limitation_and_mathematical_difference: Regular TT regression CLT already exists. No uniform claim over unknown rank and weak triangular sequences is established there.
classification: Same TT structure; regular inference already known.
evidence: Full indexed primary article Section 3 inspected; some math rendering incomplete, so no detailed penalized rate copied.
